semantic_rule: For every non-zero-radius orbit camera position C around declared subject S, horizontal pan must equal the local spherical camera-to-subject bearing, represented continuously with the accumulated commanded sweep. Zero-radius declared spins retain their authored pan sweep because target bearing is undefined.
